SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D. 5656.
Date 7 / 2 / 34

February 6 34.

Consul-General for Germany,
Shanghai.

Sir,

I have the honour to acknowledge receipt
of your letter No. W 7 dated January 27, 1934, and
in reply to inform you that P.W. Tiam may be located
at the Occidental Life Insurance Company, 10 Kiukiang
Road, where he is employed as an insurance agent.
Efforts to ascertain this man's present residence
have so far been unsuccessful, but enquiries are
being continued and the results will be made known
to you in due course.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your most obedient servant,

(Sd) F. W. Garrard
Commissioner of Police.

（批：JR）

致德国驻上海总领事，

先生：

谨此确认收到阁下1934年1月27日第W 7号来函，并回复告知，P.W. Tiam（音译）现可在九江路10号西方人寿保险公司找到，他在那里担任保险代理人。

谨此致意，
先生，
您最顺从的仆人，

（签名）F. W. Garrard
警务处处长。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
CONFIDENTIAL
REPORT

File No............
....................Station,
Date February 6, 1934.

Subject (in full) F. W. Timm - subject of inquiry from the German Consul-General.

Made by D. S. Sansom Forwarded by O. J. Somerlat

With reference to the attached letter from the German
Consul-General, dated 27.1.34, enclosing a letter from Bohler
& Co., Ltd., asking for the address of Mr. F.W. Timm, a German
subject, I have to report as follows:
Timm may be located at the Occidental Life Insurance Co.,
10 Kiukiang Road, where he is employed as an insurance agent.
Information bearing on Timm's character which has been
volunteered by persons interviewed during the course of this
inquiry goes to show that his career is quite a chequered one.
Timm makes a practice of connecting himself with any insurance
company by offering his services on a commission basis. In
this capacity he does very little business but the connection
places him in a position to obtain goods, etc., on credit
merely by using an insurance company's name as a reference.
For about five months Timm was connected with the Crown
Life Insurance Co., 10 Kiukiang Road, as a commission agent.
During this period he obtained a collective loan of approximately
$1,500.00 from officials of this company but failed to repay
same. His services with this company were terminated on
December 20, 1933 as the result of the theft of a typewriter
from Mr. T. F. Lee, assistant director of the Crown Life
Insurance Co.
Some instances of Timm obtaining goods by false pretences
and/or larceny by trick, many of which have been made possible
by quoting the name of an insurance company, are as follows:-
(1) Edward Evans & Sons Ltd., 17 Kiukiang Road. Obtaining
a typewriter by false pretences.
(2) Dodwell & Co., Canton Road. Obtaining a typewriter by
false pretences.

报告

档案号 ____ 分局，
日期 1934年2月6日。

主题（全称） F. W. Timm - 德国总领事查询之对象。

撰写人 D. S. Sansom 转呈人 O. J. Somerlat

关于附上的德国总领事1934年1月27日来函，该函附有 Bohler & Co., Ltd.（百乐兄弟有限公司）的信件，询问德籍人士 F.W. Timm 先生的地址，兹报告如下：
Timm 可在九江路10号西方人寿保险公司找到，他在那里担任保险代理人。
在此次调查过程中，受访人员主动提供的关于 Timm 品行的信息显示，他的履历相当复杂多变。Timm 惯常以佣金制的方式向任何保险公司提供服务，从而与之建立联系。在此身份下，他做的业务很少，但这种关系使他仅凭借用保险公司的名义作为担保，就能赊购货物等物。
Timm 曾以佣金代理人的身份在九江路10号的皇冠人寿保险公司任职约五个月。在此期间，他从该公司职员处获得总计约1,500.00美元的贷款，但未能偿还。1933年12月20日，由于皇冠人寿保险公司副董事 T. F. Lee 先生的一台打字机被盗，Timm 在该公司的服务被终止。
以下是 Timm 通过虚假借口和/或诈骗手段获取货物的若干案例，其中许多得以实现是因为他引用了保险公司的名义：-
(1) Edward Evans & Sons Ltd.（爱德华·埃文斯父子有限公司），九江路17号。通过虚假借口获取一台打字机。
(2) Dodwell & Co.（道威尔公司），广东路。通过虚假借口获取一台打字机。

Made by_________________________________Forwarded by______________________________________________
(2)

(3) T. F. Lee, Crown Life Insurance Co. Larceny (by trick)
of a typewriter.
(4) Commercial Equipment Co., 303 Kiangse Road. Larceny
(by trick) of a typewriter.
(5) Steel Appliance Co., 4 Canton Road. Obtaining a typewriter
by false pretences.
(6) Bolton Bristle Co., 32 Brenan Road, is said to have a claim
on Timm for certain clothing.
(7) Mrs. Dietrich (German Bar) Bubbling Well Road. Failed to
settle boarding accounts.
(8) Burlington Hotel. Failed to settle bar account.
(9) Ambassador Cabaret, Av. Edward VII. Failed to settle
account.
(10) Boarding house at 446/8 Seymour Road. Absconded without
paying board and lodging account covering a period of about
two months.

Attempts to "shadow" Timm for the purpose of locating
his residence have been unsuccessful due to the fact that he
cannot be identified with his description. The manager of the
Occidental Insurance Co. is not aware of this inquiry, and, as
it is doubtful whether Timm's residential address is known to him,
he has not been approached on the subject. Further, there is
a danger that Timm would be discharged if it were known to the
company that the police are interested in his activities; therefore,
under the circumstances, it is considered inadvisable to make
~~further~~ *further* enquiries at present. As matters stand, Timm can
easily be found by making an appointment with the Occidental
Life Insurance Co.

(4) Commercial Equipment Co.（商业设备公司），江西路303号。诈骗（通过诡计）窃取一台打字机。
(5) Steel Appliance Co.（钢铁器具公司），广东路4号。通过虚假借口获取一台打字机。
(6) Bolton Bristle Co.（博尔顿鬃毛公司），白伦路32号，据称对 Timm 拥有某些服装方面的债权。
(7) Dietrich 夫人（德国酒吧），静安寺路。未结清寄宿账目。
(8)  Burlington Hotel（伯灵顿饭店）。未结清酒吧账目。
(9) Ambassador Cabaret（大使歌舞厅），爱多亚路。未结清账目。
(10) 西摩路446/8号的寄宿公寓。未支付约两个月期间的食宿费用即潜逃。

出于定位其住址的目的而对 Timm 进行的“跟踪”尝试均未成功，原因是无法根据描述辨认出他。西方保险公司的经理并不知晓此次查询，而且鉴于 Timm 的居住地址是否为他所知尚存疑问，因此未就此事项与其接触。此外，如果公司得知警方对其活动感兴趣，Timm 有可能被解雇；因此，在这种情况下，目前认为不宜进行~~进一步~~ *进一步* 查询。就目前情况而言，只需与西方人寿保险公司预约，便可轻易找到 Timm。

此前向警方报案，因为投诉人一直抱有最终能找到 Timm 并说服其履行债务的希望。他们现在意识到，除了诉诸法庭外，寻求补救的可能性微乎其微，他们正等待此次调查结果的建议。
Edward Evans & Sons 公司的 K. Roberts 先生，以及皇冠人寿保险公司的 T. F. Lee 先生，尤其希望立即提起诉讼。毫无疑问，其他利益相关方也会乐意效仿。
似乎还有许多其他针对 Timm 的索赔案例。

D. S.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
Shanghai 27th January 1934.
No. D. 5656.
Date 30. 1. 1. 3rd

Sir,

I have the honour to hand you in the enclosure a
letter of Messrs. Bohler Bros.& Co.Ltd. asking for the
address of the German subject Mr. F. W. Timm in Shanghai.
I should be much obliged if you would render your kind
assistance and forward the reply to the above named firm
through this Consulate General which is also interested in
this information.

Thanking you in anticipation I have the honour to be,

Sir,

Your obedient servant

〔此处为手写签名〕

Acting Consul General for Germany.

〔此处有手写批注，字迹潦草难以辨认〕

Major F.W.Gerrard
Commissioner
Shanghai Municipal Police
Shanghai

Note.- Please see J Timm (20971) & C.F Timm (20.393) attached.
